title: Haaye Mera veer Hussain
body:
Ya garib ya hussain - 4
Haye mera veer hussain - 6
Shabbir de laashe te zainab ne haye ro ro paaya bayn
1. Shabbir bhira teri laashotte mai aayi rasiya paake
Tere kaatal laash chudaiye naize diya darba laake
Nai turdiya inj behna laash utta jive tur payi teri behn
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Ek hath nal tere qaatil ne tera sir zulfa to chaya
Duje hathwich mera burkacha menu zaalim aan wakhaya
Is zulm de manzar ne balde wich mere maar dite sab chayn
<<DIVIDER>>
3.ban shahid tere sajde di rayi manzar ro ro takdi
Jado gal tere te gal rakhke rayi maa zehra tur raandi
Pyaasa ayla mayi haye zaalim ku ae mera nure ayn
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Hasrat hayi kafan pava vandi nal soni kabr banesa
Par shaam da safar jado sunya muk gaiyya saariya wasa
Teri nagri wich veeran hai zaalim nahi dende menu rehn
<<DIVIDER>>
5.wich shaam wale bazar veeran jeda waqt namaz da raave
Bas yaad rakhi inj wekhi tu mere wich bazaar de sajde
Jive sattar qadam te mai wekhan rayi teri khanjar tale zohrain
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Meku aan sakina aankhdi hayi koi zaalim shimr nu aakhe
Mai baksh diyangi dur oku jede zulm de naal lahaye
Kuch der layeen meku babedi mayyat te deve bayn
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Nahi john ae matam ruk sagda ae roze hashar tayi jaari
Kyunke turbat wich ro roke di zehra darda maari
Payi wen kalendiye aj taayi meri shaam di malka sen
Ya garib ya hussain - 4
